annotations.title: Change the call summary of a voice agent

description:
Change the call summary of a voice agent

Switches the summary email after every call on or off and sets where it goes, whether it leaves out name and number (`anonymous`) and the important numbers. Fields left out keep their value. Only calls that start after switching on get a summary, usually within five minutes after the call. 409 with `details.reason` `ZERO_PII` when the agent keeps no call data, 400 with `details.reason` `INVALID_VIP` and `details.index` for a number that is not a phone number. Only agents of your own account.

body.description: The request fields as one JSON object.

vipNumbers.description: Replaces the whole list. Up to 50.

number.description: National (`0171 1234567`, read as German) or international (`+49 171 1234567`).
